entries.title: Turn off Microsoft Edge diagnostic data
entries.description: Sets the Microsoft Edge DiagnosticData policy to Off (0) so Edge sends no crash or usage diagnostic data to Microsoft.
entries.rationale: 0 = Off, 1 = Required, 2 = Optional. Edge honours this policy natively from Edge 122 on Windows; earlier versions followed the Windows diagnostic-data level. Microsoft recommends Required (1), so full Off is offered only at the Strict level.
sideEffects: Microsoft does not recommend fully disabling Edge diagnostic data; crash and usage reporting to Microsoft stops.

entries.title: Stop Edge personalisation reporting
entries.description: Sets PersonalizationReportingEnabled to 0 so Microsoft Edge stops sending browsing history, favourites, collections and usage data used for ad and content personalisation.
entries.rationale: Disables the personalisation data feed with no functional side effects; browsing is unaffected. Available since Edge 80.

entries.title: Disable Edge feedback collection
entries.description: Sets UserFeedbackAllowed to 0 so the 'Send feedback' UI and feedback prompts in Microsoft Edge are removed.
entries.rationale: Feedback submissions upload usage context and screenshots on demand; disabling the surface removes an interruption with no functional loss.
sideEffects: The Send feedback UI and feedback prompts are removed from Edge.

entries.title: Turn off the Edge shopping assistant
entries.description: Sets EdgeShoppingAssistantEnabled to 0 so Microsoft Edge stops coupon, price-tracking and shopping-comparison features.
entries.rationale: The shopping assistant inspects the pages you visit to surface offers; disabling it removes that page inspection with no impact on normal browsing.
sideEffects: Coupon and price-tracking features are removed from Edge.

entries.title: Restrict the Edge experimentation and configuration service
entries.description: Sets ExperimentationAndConfigurationServiceControl to RestrictedMode (0) so Microsoft Edge does not download experiment or configuration payloads from Microsoft.
entries.rationale: 0 = RestrictedMode, 1 = ConfigurationsOnly (default for managed devices), 2 = Full. Microsoft does not recommend RestrictedMode because it also stops site-compatibility fixes, so it is offered only at the Paranoid level. Available since Edge 77.
sideEffects: Edge stops receiving Microsoft-delivered site-compatibility configuration payloads, which can cause rendering issues on sites that rely on them.

entries.title: Hide the Edge first-run experience
entries.description: Sets HideFirstRunExperience to 1 so Microsoft Edge skips the first-run onboarding flow, its data-collection prompts and default import offers.
entries.rationale: The first-run experience prompts for personalisation, sign-in and data import; hiding it avoids those prompts. It does not change how Edge browses.
sideEffects: The first-run onboarding, personalisation and import prompts are skipped.

entries.title: Turn off Edge Spotlight recommendations
entries.description: Sets SpotlightExperiencesAndRecommendationsEnabled to 0 so Microsoft Edge stops Bing background images, text and suggestions on the new-tab page.
entries.rationale: Spotlight content is fetched and personalised from Microsoft services; disabling it produces a quieter new-tab page with no functional loss.
sideEffects: Bing background images and suggestions are removed from the new-tab page.

entries.title: Turn off Edge feature nags and promotions
entries.description: Disables Microsoft Edge feature recommendations, Edge Insider promotions, default-browser campaigns and the Acrobat subscription button.
entries.rationale: These surfaces nag the user to enable Edge features or Microsoft subscriptions and can call promotion services; turning them off removes the prompts without affecting browsing. The deprecated PromotionalTabsEnabled value is intentionally not written.
sideEffects: Feature recommendations, Insider promotions, default-browser campaigns and the Acrobat subscription button no longer appear in Edge.

entries.title: Disable Edge Collections
entries.description: Sets EdgeCollectionsEnabled to 0 so the Microsoft Edge Collections feature is unavailable.
entries.rationale: Collections can sync saved content through Microsoft services. Disabling it removes that cloud surface; this is offered at the Strict level because it removes a feature some users rely on.
sideEffects: The Collections feature is removed from Edge.

entries.title: Disable the Microsoft Edge web widget
entries.description: Sets WebWidgetAllowed to 0 so the Microsoft Edge web widget (the Edge-powered desktop widget) is disabled.
entries.rationale: The web widget surfaces a personalised Edge-powered feed on the desktop; disabling it removes that content feed with no impact on the browser itself.
sideEffects: The Microsoft Edge web widget is disabled.

entries.title: Disable the ProgramDataUpdater scheduled task
entries.description: Disables the Application Experience task that collects program telemetry for the Customer Experience Improvement Program (CEIP).
entries.rationale: The task only gathers program inventory when CEIP is enabled and has no effect otherwise; disabling it stops that collection at the Balanced level.
sideEffects: No effect while CEIP is disabled; feature updates may re-enable the task.

entries.title: Disable Customer Experience Improvement Program tasks
entries.description: Disables the CEIP Consolidator and UsbCeip scheduled tasks that collect and upload Customer Experience Improvement Program data.
entries.rationale: These tasks are dormant when CEIP is disabled (CEIPEnable=0); disabling them provides a belt-and-braces stop with no functional loss.
sideEffects: These tasks are already dormant when CEIP is off; feature updates may re-enable them.

entries.title: Disable the Autochk Proxy scheduled task
entries.description: Disables the Autochk\Proxy task that uploads autochk SQM data for Customer Experience Improvement Program participants.
entries.rationale: The task only uploads SQM data for CEIP participants and is a no-op when CEIP is off; disabling it removes the upload path at the Basic level.
sideEffects: No effect while CEIP is disabled; feature updates may re-enable the task.

entries.title: Disable Feedback Hub SIUF scheduled tasks
entries.description: Disables the Feedback\Siuf DmClient and DmClientOnScenarioDownload tasks that drive Feedback Hub telemetry and diagnostic-scenario downloads.
entries.rationale: These tasks upload feedback scenario data and fetch diagnostic-scenario definitions; disabling them stops that traffic. Re-enable them if you want to file feedback through the Feedback Hub.
sideEffects: Feedback Hub scenario downloads stop; re-enable if you want to submit feedback. Feature updates may re-enable the tasks.

entries.title: Disable the Windows Error Reporting upload task
entries.description: Disables the Windows Error Reporting\QueueReporting task that uploads queued Windows Error Reporting reports to Microsoft.
entries.rationale: Queued WER reports can contain file paths and memory contents. Disabling the upload task pairs with turning Windows Error Reporting off and is offered at the Strict level.
sideEffects: Queued Windows Error Reporting reports are no longer uploaded; pair with turning WER off. Feature updates may re-enable the task.

entries.title: Disable the Device Census scheduled tasks
entries.description: Disables the Device Information\Device and Device User tasks that run DeviceCensus.exe to build the device census sent to Microsoft.
entries.rationale: DeviceCensus collects hardware and configuration inventory for diagnostics. Offered only at the Strict level for unmanaged devices, because Windows Update for Business reporting depends on it.
sideEffects: Windows Update for Business update reporting relies on DeviceCensus; leave these enabled on managed devices. Feature updates may re-enable the tasks.
